meta.claim: defendant B: REBOOTING and REBINDING have the same graph shape -- exactly one in-neighbor, two outgoing edges, both toward BOUND and INIT -- so they could be swapped
meta.why_it_looks_legal: degree signatures match exactly: one in-neighbor each (INIT-REBOOT vs RENEWING), and both leave toward {BOUND, INIT}
meta.why_it_is_not_a_symmetry: the in-neighborhoods are themselves non-interchangeable (INIT-REBOOT has 2 outgoing edges and no incoming ones; RENEWING has 3 outgoing and 1 incoming), and the event labels differ ('DHCPNAK/Discard offer' vs 'DHCPNAK, Lease expired/Halt network')
